proof_body:
by
  intro f a x n hax hf hd
  obtain ⟨c, hc, e⟩ := taylor_mean_remainder_cauchy hax hf hd
  refine ⟨c, hc, ?_⟩
  rw [taylor_within_apply] at e
  have hs : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), iteratedDerivWithin k f (Set.uIcc a x) a / (k.factorial : ℝ) * (x - a) ^ k = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((k.factorial : ℝ)⁻¹ * (x - a) ^ k) • iteratedDerivWithin k f (Set.uIcc a x) a := by
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
    rw [smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  rw [hs, ← e]
  ring
target_source: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a x : ℝ) (n : ℕ), a ≠ x → ContDiffOn ℝ n f (Set.uIcc a x) → DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDerivWithin n f (Set.uIcc a x)) (Set.uIoo a x) → ∃ c ∈ Set.uIoo a x, f x = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), iteratedDerivWithin k f (Set.uIcc a x) a / (k.factorial : ℝ) * (x - a) ^ k + iteratedDerivWithin (n + 1) f (Set.uIcc a x) c * (x - c) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ) * (x - a)
